{'translation': 'I first noted the impressive video stabilization on the iPhone when testing the iPhone 13 Pro back in 2021. The feature has been refined ever since, with the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro now offering what Apple calls "super-stabilized video recording".', 'replaced': False}

{'translation': 'It might not sound glamorous, but it makes a huge practical difference for handheld shooting, and my recent testing showed just how good it now is...', 'replaced': False}

{'translation': "I own a small tripod and a GorillaPod, and I bring them along whenever I expect to shoot video with my iPhone. But the iPhone's biggest advantage is that you always have it in your pocket. Sometimes I spot a shooting opportunity, but I've left the tripod at home.", 'replaced': False}

{'translation': "Improvised shooting usually works: you can rest the iPhone against a railing, or use a lamppost to brace your body. But sometimes I rely on the iPhone's built-in video stabilization, and my recent shoot with the iPhone 18 Pro genuinely blew me away.", 'replaced': False}

{'translation': "A boat trip along the Thames proved that the iPhone's built-in video stabilization can sometimes outperform a tripod. The vessel was rocking heavily, which would normally result in footage where the boat stays steady but the view outside moves about; the iPhone instead locked onto the outside world, letting the boat wobble freely in the foreground.", 'replaced': False}

{'translation': "Maintaining a stable horizon regardless of how the platform moves is something most gimbals cannot achieve. Most consumer gimbals simply smooth out the vibrations rather than eliminate them. Apart from high-end professional gimbals and the gyroscopic mounts designed for boats and helicopters, it's hard to find a product on the market that truly locks the horizon.", 'replaced': False}

{'translation': 'The super-stabilization on the iPhone 18 Pro genuinely reaches that level, which is remarkable for a feature built into the stock Camera app with no extra hardware required.', 'replaced': False}

{'translation': "Watch the demo clip below. If you don't want to sit through the entire boat journey, skip to the Tower Bridge section, as that part showcases the feature's power best. If you're into London sightseeing, hit the C button for captions — you'll see the names of all the bridges and other annotations, plus a glimpse of Apple's UK headquarters.", 'replaced': False}
